integrity: The interval-union proof is self-contained, finite checks are reproducible, and all claimed independent review is explicitly absent.
limitations: The result treats L_{6,1}^d, not every nondistributive lattice.

scope: For every integer m at least 4, the explicitly specified 2-valued unary algebra has congruence lattice isomorphic to L_{6,1}^d; no smaller carrier is possible.
title: The full carrier spectrum of a six-element nondistributive lattice
